reviews.title: The worst service
reviews.text: Staff are unbelievably rude. I had headphones yanked off my head during their pre-flight brief and then the same member of staff refused to serve me anything the rest of the flight or acknowledge I was there. No conversation was offered regarding the headphones. She insulted me multiple times in Romanian thinking I didn't understand (I did). Bags took more than 1 hour to arrive when we disembarked. I asked how I could complain, was not given any details. The lead of the cabin crew refused to even give me paper to make some notes. I wasn't permitted the staff member's name or even a number, I was eventually told I had to complain on their website, which doesn't work. Awful service. Check in was slow, I waited in line more than 40 minutes as there was no option to bag drop if online checked in, all TAROM flights check in the same place regardless of departure. Staff are rude at all desks. My husband has flown TAROM since and was delayed more than 5 hours in London which no reason given. The TAROM website again doesn't offer any way to claim your EU required compensation for such a delay. Again, being corrupt and terrible. Well done TAROM (sarcastic)
reviews.author: Holly Stephens

reviews.title: Delay is never refunded
reviews.text: I used to be travelling with Tarom for almost a year and I was tolerating everything (old jets, moody stuff, delays etc), but last time when I had a connected flight from Chisinau to Budapest with the connection in Bucharest, my flight was delayed and they gave me another tickets with Austrian airlines with the connection in Vienna. In the result my flight was 6 hours delayed! Because of this delay I also missed my bus in Budapest! I've applied for the refund on April 4th and they told me it would take 45 days to give me an answer. Well, now we are in mid June, still no answer even though I've texted them a couple of times. Really Tarom is far not the cheapest airlines, but definitely the worst ones.
reviews.author: Karina

reviews.title: Always delays - crew that is moody
reviews.text: Tarom is mostly delayed. Below average service and very unfriendly cabin crew. If there should be worked faster due to some kind of delay they don’t seem te care at all.
reviews.author: Barry M

reviews.title: Don't buy Tarom.
reviews.text: It was assigned to us by Air France after they had changed our flights. Tarom is dirty with awful service and terrible flying conditions.
reviews.author: VioletaGorcheva

reviews.title: Never book a flight from Tarom
reviews.text: I don’t even have words for how bad this company is, there is not a single thing that works for them. They do not answer the phone, they don’t answer the support mail, it’s just completely terrible. They cancelled both my flights two days before departure and wouldn’t give me any kind of response or compensation, I still haven’t heard from them and probably won’t. My biggest recommendation is to neeever travel with tarom. If I could give them 0 starts I for sure would.
reviews.author: Casper S

reviews.title: Poor hospitality skills
reviews.text: I turned up-to gate 22 from Bucharest to Athens with my partner ,The gate said check in closed but the light was still on ,There was a quecue at fare 23 but no info or light I walked to the front and enquired was this the line for Athens only to be shouted at yes get back into line and then the young lady turned to her colleague and said you see what I have to put up with , this is extremely rude and they were at fault Surely it makes sense to check your clients in from the correct gate that was illuminated and stating the correct destination , I think your checking in staff need to be retrained in the art of dealing with clients and at no point do you ever shout at a customer. My flight today was at 16.40 to Athens ( may the 4th) I hope you can speak to your staff with regards to this and get them to work in there hospitality skills. Regards Hugh Pettifer
reviews.author: Hugh P

reviews.title: Flight was delay for 2:30 for unknown reason.  Would not offer any compensation for delays under 3 hours.
reviews.text: Flight was delay for 2:30 for unknown reason. Would not offer any compensation for delays under 3 hours. We did not get any notification until 1.5 hour before departure. We were already on the taxi almost at the airport. Had to wait 3 hours at the airport. The Tarom agent told us that the company does not tell them the reason for the delay. Will definitely avoid flying Tarom in the future.
reviews.author: The Adventurer

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I have never seen such a company in my life. An airline that I can cancel the ticket I bought and cannot reach them either by e-mail or by phone. I try to call them and wait for a hour on the phone . Also , i sent 3 mails with asap , there is not an answer yet . Comedyair
reviews.author: Yim Ayhan E

reviews.title: Worst company ever!!!!
reviews.text: I am EXTREMELY disappointed by this company. Over 40 days waiting for them to refund me for the extra money I had to pay due to return flight cancelled. I have sent all receipts and I am keeping asking for my money back and all these incompetents can say is that my case is still under review. What the hell do you still have to review? You cancelled my flight and besides that you keep my money stuck with you! Thieves!
reviews.author: Elisa D

reviews.title: Tarom is not a professional company!
reviews.text: With Tarom airlines, they changed the transfer day to 1 day before on our connecting flight to Bucharest. Normally we did not have accommodation in Bucharest, but due to this change, we had to stay in Bucharest for 1 night. Because of this situation they caused from Tarom, we requested accommodation. Because it says on their website that accommodation will be organized for such changes! However, it is never possible to reach by phone. They did not give a single reply to our emails. We used all the e-mail addresses on their website. We wrote on social media. But not a single person answered! Tarom is a regret! I will never book this company again! Right now I'm skeptical about how to deliver my luggage to them. In case of a possible loss, you may not even be able to reach customer representations (I think there is none). Because there is no way to contact Tarom! Tarom=Never again!
reviews.author: Sefa G

reviews.title: Congrats to Tarom Airlines
reviews.text: I had a flight from Athens to Bucharest before some days. I forgot my pocket with a large amount of money . They find my name in one card and they call me in the number that I book my flight to give me back my pocket . With this post I want to thank the person who finds my stuff and the Tarom Airlines 🙏🙏
reviews.author: Anastasios K

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Yesterday was my first time flying with Tarom. I’m been extremely impressed with the service! All the staff including the Pilot has been really helpful,nice and friendly! I been travelling with my baby and they help me with the luggage. Thank you so much! I will definitely choose Tarom in my next trip!
reviews.author: Gabriela A

reviews.title: Very basic airline. A bit concerned though
reviews.text: Ok the Staff are polite, the plane is clean, but the Boing 737 which we boarded had "Cathodic" Tv display for flight route. I thought hold on i have not seen a cathodic tv in used for more than 25 years. I had to google the fleet and found the plane is about 28 years old! Honestly time to upgrade the fleet Tarom! you will not attract clients by running such old planes
reviews.author: Sami N

reviews.title: You feel you’re in the middle of Africa with this airline
reviews.text: This airline is a joke, an embarrassment!! Even probably in the middle of the jungle you get better service and flights then you get with Tarom. Do not use, rather drive then use this airline 🤦🏻‍♂️🤦🏻‍♂️
reviews.author: Prestige E

reviews.title: They fly plane like pro's even on harsh weather conditions
reviews.text: Extremely good value for money, if you talk politely to them and ask about things, the flight crew could offer some perks and add-ons. The tickets are not that expensive and the operating officers fly the plane like real pro's, even in tough weather conditions. If you prefer speaking Romanian, book this company without hesitations, they all speak Romanian and treat passengers like returning customers.
reviews.author: Johny W

reviews.title: DO NOT CHOOSE THIS AIRLINE, IF YOU VALUE YOUR BAGGAGE AND TIME
reviews.text: My first flight with Tarom was delayed for more than 3 hours, and during this delay NO INFORMATION from Tarom representatives was given to us. And THIS TIME, during my second flight(which was a mistake), when we had to chose flight with Tarom, I arrived and found that my suitcase was TOTALLY DAMAGED, and it was evident from the damage that someone just violently threw the suitcase upside down, and threw it with such force that it still slid in this position. Staff in airport gave us a damage report, and after that we contacted Tarom representatives by email, bought new suitcase in different country with higher prices, wasted so much time and money for that, after that we didn't hear anything for 10 days, paid additional money to contact Tarom by call from abroad, and lady only said we need to contact other Tarom email and wait 45 days more until they process our application. It's good that we kept all receipts, papers and luggage stickers from the airport. Otherwise, we would have nothing to rely on. At the moment we are waiting for any result or answer.
reviews.author: Maxim

reviews.title: Cancelled my flight ticket and wouldn't give a refund
reviews.text: Tarom cancelled my flight that was supposed to be from July 12 2023 till August 18 2023. They cancelled my ticket on November 4, 2022 without any explanation and didn't even notify me, I had to find out on my own. I have tried contacting them several times by email but I never get a reply. This airline can't be trusted whatsoever.
reviews.author: Mira A

reviews.title: Delayed flight and wrong pick-up baggage airport.
reviews.text: Hi ,everybody! Strictly don’t recommend you to use this airlines. I was going to Riga from Bucharest via transit through Brussels . During the check-in I asked the question about my baggage (where I have to pick-up it) and they said « in Brussel for re-check »after that I asked one more time «Are you sure ?because my final destination is Riga» and they gathered a consilium discussed it with each other and said «Yes,in Brussel». But it was wrong because my flights was connected and I was have to pick-up baggage in Riga (final destination).Huge mistake from the Tarom operator during check-in that leads for a big problems to me. Moreover,my flight from Bucharest to Brussel was delayed for almost 35 min and I arrived in Brussel in 6:05 pm instead of 5:30pm. The gap between flights Bucharest - Brussel/Brussel - Riga was 1.5 hour and that is enough time even to pick baggage/pass passport control and go for re-check ,but with out 35 min delay . As a result I missed my flight to Riga,because when I arrived to my check-in after all formalities with passport and baggage it was already closed and I stucked for 1 day in Brussels with destroyed plans . The worst airline company that I have ever used! Just avoid them!!! P.S. for the evidence I have just attached the photos with the stickers from my baggage.
reviews.author: KRYZHNYY VLADYSLAV

reviews.title: The worst customer service ever.
reviews.text: I have traveled quite a lot by plane, and I can say that this is by far the worst customer service I've ever had. Not helpful at all for people traveling with a wheelchair. I don't recommend it.
reviews.author: Arbol D

reviews.title: Very bad customer service
reviews.text: I bought 4 round trip tickets. Then the Covid19 pandemia arrived and the flight was cancelled. They promised to give me a full refund within 90 days. It's been over two years now and I still haven't received the money. At some point they even stopped answering my emails completely and even blocked me on Facebook! If this is the attitude towards the customers, then I recommend everyone to fly with another airline that treats its customers with respect and fairness. Shame on you TAROM !
reviews.author: Dov R

reviews.title: Be aware!
reviews.text: Let's start with the good parts: price was decent for a non-budget airline and that is about it. Boarding from Bucharest was like with any budget airline by bus although they are the national airline company and the airport has walkways. The planes are old but wouldn't really matter but the trimmings inside are ....you can see in the pictures. Service inside is....absent all we got for a morning flight was a glass of water. The team inside is profesionnal but hospitality is nothing to reflect our countries true aspect. How hard can it be to smile or use a pleasant tone?? This review comes from a national and I am really sad to see this.
reviews.author: Dream48801

reviews.title: Disaster
reviews.text: DISASTER !!! Left late, the stewardese a nd pilots went in the same bus with passangers ( we had to wait for them )and we are in the bus im front of airport sitting for 10 minutes already. VERY POOR SERVICES!!!
reviews.author: Daniel O

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: First, we were told that hand baggage size has changed no longer allowed the size we had but the person at the counter asked us for a 50RON bribe to mask everything and accept our luggages that were technically within the limits but we were told that they were not, so we were upset. So to avoid a show in front of everyone we did what we were asked. Secondly, the staff on the airplane is rude, yells, and does not smile. Very poor customer service skills. No coffee, tea, or a small snack provided. What kind of airline does that??? Only plain water on request. I used KLM before for the same exact route and they were stellar,waaaayyy better compared to these jerks from TAROM. I'll never use TAROM ever again. I will be extrenlmely careful and look for TAROM never show up in my flight itineraries ever again. Not recommended at all! I wonder what the role of the freaking flight attendant crew is, or what they get paid for, because apparently they are there just to fill up the space in the back.
reviews.author: Sasha Sasha

reviews.title: Unprofessional and scamming
reviews.text: Some years ago it was way better, now Tarom is just a low coast company that only tries to trick people. Out of the sudden they changed the regulations and the checked in luggage is not included in the price so at the airport I had to buy my luggage. No information regarding this on the website and I flew with them just a week before!!. The website is old and communist, with a bad interface, not user friendly. The staff is terrible. I’m not choosing Tarom ever again, I was only choosing it because of the luggage that was included in the price. Be it cost be double the tickets. They can forget me as a customer and I hights won’t recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: JUST CHOOSE Turkish instead
reviews.text: I have written about this airline before but Having been forced to change due to a schedule change I boarded the above sitting in 2 C - Business class with Turkish gives you a happy smiling crew a modern aircraft in the most part an A330 a fabulous Breakfast hot three courses Tarom s presentation was a crew with not a smile between them , a captain that took on a no talking role all in an old A 318 - Breakfast was a bottle of water - not a whiff of coffee - NOTHING - how are these people in Sky Team ? - what planet are they on - Business class is a fraud - truly awful in this day and age
reviews.author: John R

reviews.title: Worse airline ever
reviews.text: The staff were unprofessional from the customer service phone gent who hung up and refused to answer any questions about my delayed flight to the gate agents who disappeared as soon as the delay was announced leaving the passengers with no one to ask any questions. The flight crew offered a half cup of water as a cabin smack and refused to honor the EU rule that requires that any delay of 2hrs should be given meal etc. Overall horrible experience I hope to never have again.

reviews.text: Extremely bad experience!!! Try NOT to fly Taom!!! Extremely bad experience!!! Try NOT to fly Taom!!! Extremely bad experience!!! Try NOT to fly Taom!!! Extremely bad experience!!! Try NOT to fly Taom!!! Extremely bad experience!!! Try NOT to fly Taom!!!
reviews.author: Motioster

reviews.title: no room for my legs
reviews.text: The flight was short, the plane was clean, the crew was polite, the refreshment was a glass of water and the space between the seats was next to none
reviews.author: yoramafek

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: I had a speaker inside my bad, upon opening the bag, after landing in Bucharest, I realised my speaker has marks and dents on it. Speaker was wrapped in clothes and air bubbles. All the marks are around on one side and around an area thar can be opened. The bag was opened and the speaker as well. Either opened or dropped. After complaining on Tarom website 2 weeks ago, asking for an explanation, I have received nothing back. Sent another email and still no response whatsoever. My bag was opened and the speaker was opened or dropped and Tarom refuses to offer any explanation whatsoever. I won't fly with this company every again. Not to mention the aircraft is an old aircraft, the noise inside is pretty stressful and the flight from London to Bucharest was pretty uncomfortable. They fact that my bag was opened and they refuse to give any explanation makes this airline an airline that should not exist inside EU. I have also contacted London authorities and all of them told me to contact TAROM as they are handling the bags. Tarom unfortunately doesn't care. Never again.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Best flight i have every had
reviews.text: Just arrived in London for an onward fight to New York - our experience on our flight on the Airbus 318 has been exceptional made all the more comfortable and enjoyable by our very attentive and professional cabin staff - Andrea and Valerica - thank you for excellent service it was much appreciated and well done Tarom for your excellent choice in staff. This airline is honestly awsome and I recommend that you chose them over ryanair or wizz air.
reviews.author: FaZe_Discharge
